metadata.basis: minimal real native-compiler workload with compiler-produced wire facts
metadata.remainingGap: Nested nominal field resolution must use the declaring module; the original store host-side canonical identity construction concern remains.

reproduction.instructions: Using the current compiler campaign source, compile a one-module ProjectSnapshot with compile_project, preserve the returned typed flow.LoweredUnit wire value, then call mncs.compiler.ssa.v1::lower_value_ssa<N=1024> in a retained Cranelift session. It returns invalid_request with expected finite identity mncs.compiler.ssa.v1::FunctionList and received mncs.compiler.flow.v1::FunctionList.

summary: A retained Cranelift execution of the compiler-produced flow.LoweredUnit passed to mncs.compiler.ssa.v1::lower_value_ssa reproduces a nested nominal contract mismatch at argument 1.functions: flow.FunctionList is decoded as ssa.FunctionList because the language-owned backend contract builder resolves the nested field by short name. The original mncs-store host-spelling limitation remains a separate part of this record.
